purpose: Reusable VERIFY/QA block for existing worker packets/work graph with asynchronous candidate visibility, bounded repair feedback and promotion-ready evidence.

owner_reuse_map.acceptance_promotion: existing project Current/Human Accepted/Served authority; this contract has none

verify_block_v1.selection_rule: Run the cheapest depth that proves every applicable vector. Browser/visual lanes are selected only when an acceptance vector explicitly requires served interaction or visual evidence.

candidate_visibility.rule: A reversible candidate may remain visible while asynchronous QA is pending unless an explicit PRE_USABLE vector or existing safety/privacy/authority policy requires holding it.

repair_feedback.rule: A material FAIL creates only a bounded repair_successor_candidate with failed vector refs, candidate/version refs, done_when and consumer=REVERIFY. Existing GUIDE_INTEGRATOR successor dedup must materialize it; this block does not create ownership.
repair_feedback.reverify: A repaired candidate carries supersedes_candidate_id/version and enters VERIFY again with the same still-applicable vectors.

promotion.pass: All required vectors PASS produces QA_PASS evidence and a promotion-ready signal.
promotion.human_required: If existing policy requires human approval, compact projection is READY_TO_PROMOTE and no promotion occurs until that authority acts.
promotion.auto_allowed: If existing authority already permits automatic promotion, emit AUTO_PROMOTION_ELIGIBLE_SIGNAL; the existing promotion owner may act. This block still does not mutate Current/Human Accepted/Served.

served_asset_canary.source: Primary Chat progress-v1.js stable-URL cache incident
served_asset_canary.rule: UI acceptance must compare source bytes, staged/published bytes and content-derived served asset version before representative interaction is considered current.

truth_boundary: QA evidence is verification evidence only. No scheduler, QA queue, version registry, liveness authority, acceptance authority, promotion authority or worker family is created.
